scope: Loose100-source heard-word handwriting module in the existing Klink task/teacher plan; no new course programme or scheduled meeting.
bookGoalReference: Existing Klink teacher guide section8:explicitly choose copying or writing without a visible model; the native100 HS-source learning objectives remain separately preserved.
bookGoalEvidence: Actual pointer strokes from heard words, model only on requested Help or after the first saved attempt; compare own writing with the word model. Participation is not an automatic handwriting or spelling verdict.
existingTeacherPlan: docs/KLINK-DOCENTHANDLEIDING.md sections8,10,11; select a few suitable source words within the real group lesson.
lessonPlanStatus: Concrete adaptation within the existing15-minute example block, to be entered in the real group plan; actual book page and scheduled meeting not supplied.

observations.task: Choose three to five known/suitable target words for heard-word handwriting.
observations.teacherAction: Record the book goal and actual time; check target audio and the pointing device; explain whether written model help is allowed.
observations.learnerBehaviour: Indicates the writing area and explains or shows the intended task.
observations.material: Existing book/word cards, original target recordings and the actual screen writing area.

observations.task: Demonstrate a line and the compare action with a separate demonstration word.
observations.teacherAction: Keep the actual target model hidden when unaided first writing is desired; explain that compare shows a model and does not recognize or grade handwriting.
observations.learnerBehaviour: Produces their own strokes and starts the intended task.
observations.material: Actual mouse/touch/pen writing surface and target recording.

observations.sourceHeading: Actief oefenen en samenwerken; hulp, tempo en een veilige sfeer
observations.task: Listen, handwrite a word, compare and correct; repeat for the selected short word set.
observations.teacherAction: Allow thinking time; watch letter formation and give one specific clue. Do not write the response for the learner. Note off-screen teacher/peer support separately.
observations.learnerBehaviour: Writes first own version, requests Help when needed and changes their own writing; first/latest versions remain separate.
observations.material: Screen ink, target word model and existing teacher observation notes.

observations.task: Show one own written word and the model; say what changed or needs practice.
observations.teacherAction: Record the observed attempt, support and next real lesson date. Use observation for handwriting/spelling judgement, not the completion mark.
observations.learnerBehaviour: Compares their own current writing with the model and identifies a change.
observations.material: Current own writing/model and existing lesson-plan note fields.

timeCounting: Within one selected existing lesson block;15 active minutes in this example only. Add no prescribed homework, duplicate minutes, new hours variant or assumed real timetable; count pauses and independent work separately in the actual plan.
openAtGroupLevel: real scheduled meeting, teacher word selection and times
